say: This week, Google signed to buy power from its maker.
Why burn rock instead of drilling?
Every kilometer down adds about 25 degrees, enough to wreck drill bits.
But super-hot water carries far more energy.
So a fusion-style beam vaporizes rock, and gas blows it out.
The catch: the first wells will still use ordinary drills.
If beams scale, Earth's heat could run data centers day and night.
Follow Media Diet for the physics behind the headlines.
